name: Motion
tagline: A calm, content-first React design system

ai.title: Using with AI
ai.description: Give your AI assistant the rules and the full API, so what it builds looks and behaves like Motion.

blocks/app-frame.title: App Frame
blocks/app-frame.description: The app window: a sidebar docked on desktop (collapsible, animated) that becomes a modal drawer on phones, a top bar over a scrolling page, and an overlay layer for peeks.

blocks/block-action-menu.title: Block action menu
blocks/block-action-menu.description: The menu that opens from a block’s ⋮⋮ handle: search, Turn into and Color submenus, Copy link, Duplicate, Move to, Delete, Comment, Ask AI, and a “Last edited” footer.

blocks/board-view.title: Board View
blocks/board-view.description: Kanban columns grouped by a status or select property. Cards drag between columns and reorder within one.

blocks/bookmark.title: Bookmark
blocks/bookmark.description: The web bookmark: a bordered card with the page title, description and URL, and an optional thumbnail on the right.

blocks/calendar-view.title: Calendar View
blocks/calendar-view.description: Month grid of rows placed on their date property. Drag an event to another day; hover a day to add a page.

blocks/callout.title: Callout
blocks/callout.description: The callout: an emoji and text in a rounded, tinted box. Defaults to 💡 on gray; any block color works.

blocks/chart-view.title: Chart View
blocks/chart-view.description: The locked (upgrade) state, or a vertical bar chart of row counts grouped by a property.

blocks/code.title: Code
blocks/code.description: The code block: monospaced text on a tinted card. Hovering shows the language button (top left) and Copy (top right).

blocks/columns.title: Columns
blocks/columns.description: The column list: 2–5 side-by-side columns separated by 46px gutters, each holding any blocks.

blocks/database.title: Database
blocks/database.description: Databases as plain data plus React views: a typed collection schema, rows, saved views with filters and sorts, a state hook and seven layouts.

blocks/database-view.title: Database View
blocks/database-view.description: The database block: title, view tabs (with “N more…”), toolbar (filter, sort, search, settings, New) and the active layout.

blocks/date-cell-picker.title: Date Cell Picker
blocks/date-cell-picker.description: The date property popover: typed date input, month calendar, end date / time switches and Clear.

blocks/divider.title: Divider
blocks/divider.description: The divider block: a 1px hairline in a 13px row. Created by typing `---`.

blocks/editor.title: Editor
blocks/editor.description: The full block editor over a `Block[]` document: Enter/Backspace/Tab semantics, markdown shortcuts, the `/` slash menu, the hover `+` and ⋮⋮ handle with the block menu, drag to reorder, and the selection text toolbar.

blocks/equation.title: Equation
blocks/equation.description: The block equation: centered display math from a TeX expression. The renderer is a light TeX-ish approximation (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, Greek letters and common symbols), with no KaTeX dependency.

blocks/filter-sort-menus.title: Filter & Sort Menus
blocks/filter-sort-menus.description: “Filter by…” and “Sort by…” property pickers, plus the editors behind the filter and sort rule pills.

blocks/gallery-view.title: Gallery View
blocks/gallery-view.description: Cards with a page preview area and the title, in a responsive grid.

blocks/heading.title: Heading
blocks/heading.description: The Heading 1–3 blocks (plus Heading 4) at weight 600, sized in em of the 16px content. Any heading can be a toggle heading.

blocks/image.title: Image
blocks/image.description: The image block: a centered image with radius 4 and an optional caption. With no `src` it shows the “Add an image” placeholder.

blocks/list.title: Bulleted & numbered list
blocks/list.description: Bulleted and numbered list items. Markers change with nesting depth: • ◦ ▪ for bullets, 1. a. i. for numbers, cycling every three levels.

blocks/list-view.title: List View
blocks/list-view.description: Minimal rows: page icon and title on the left, visible properties as small pills on the right.

blocks/new-view-menu.title: Views Menu & New View
blocks/new-view-menu.description: The “N more…” list of views and the “Add a new view” layout grid that opens beside it.

blocks/overview.title: Block model
blocks/overview.description: Every piece of a page is a block. `@krackedui/motion` models a page as a `Block[]` tree and renders it with consistent block spacing; the same tree drives the read-only renderer and the editor.

blocks/page-header.title: Page Header
blocks/page-header.description: The top of a page: optional icon, the title (`h1`, editable in place), a description and right-aligned actions, plus the Add icon / cover / comment controls.

blocks/page-layout.title: Page Layout
blocks/page-layout.description: The scrolling page frame: a 3-column grid with a 720px content column (16px gutters on phones), an optional cover, the page header and a table-of-contents rail.

blocks/page-link.title: Page link
blocks/page-link.description: The sub-page / link-to-page block: page icon plus an underlined 500-weight title.

blocks/page-title.title: Page title
blocks/page-title.description: The 40px bold page title at the top of a page, with an optional 78px emoji icon above it.

blocks/peek.title: Peek
blocks/peek.description: Open a page without leaving the current one: the side peek docked at the right edge, or the center peek modal. Both share the top bar and body parts.

blocks/property-list.title: Property List
blocks/property-list.description: The editable property table under a database page’s title (side peek and full page), plus the per-property cell and value renderers.

blocks/property-menu.title: Property Menu
blocks/property-menu.description: The menu behind a table column header: rename, change type, filter, sort, group, hide, wrap, insert, duplicate, delete.

blocks/quote.title: Quote
blocks/quote.description: The quote block: a 3px bar in the current text color, with text starting 33px in.

blocks/rich-text.title: Rich text
blocks/rich-text.description: Renders a `RichText` value inline: marks, links, inline code, colors, emoji and mentions. Every text block uses it; use it directly inside your own components.

blocks/select-picker.title: Select Picker
blocks/select-picker.description: Select, multi-select and status picker: selected tokens with search, the option list, and “Create” for new options.

blocks/settings-modal.title: Settings Modal
blocks/settings-modal.description: The “Settings & members” dialog: a 240px searchable nav of groups and tabs, and a scrolling 800px content column of sections and rows.

blocks/shell-menus.title: Shell Menus
blocks/shell-menus.description: Menus opened from the sidebar bottom bar: workspace switcher, help / what’s new, and Library · Trash.

blocks/sidebar.title: Sidebar
blocks/sidebar.description: App navigation: header, sections of links, a keyboard-navigable page tree, footer and bottom bar. Inside an AppFrame it docks, floats when collapsed, and becomes the phone drawer.

blocks/simple-table.title: Simple table
blocks/simple-table.description: The simple table block (not a database): a grid of rich-text cells with an optional header row and header column.

blocks/slash-menu.title: Slash menu
blocks/slash-menu.description: The “/” command menu: insert or convert blocks. Shown here statically; inside the Editor it opens under the caret when you type `/`.

blocks/table-of-contents.title: Table of contents
blocks/table-of-contents.description: The table of contents block: links to the page’s headings, indented 24px per level. Inside `BlockRenderer` it collects the headings automatically.

blocks/table-view.title: Table View
blocks/table-view.description: Spreadsheet layout: resizable columns, editable cells, row selection, an OPEN button on the title and an optional calculation footer.

blocks/text.title: Text
blocks/text.description: The paragraph block: 16/24 rich text with inline marks, colors, links and mentions. Child blocks indent under it.

blocks/text-toolbar.title: Text toolbar
blocks/text-toolbar.description: The card that appears over a text selection (a vertical toolbar): block type, color, bold / italic / underline / clear, link / strike / code / equation, Comment, Skills and “Edit with AI”.

blocks/timeline-view.title: Timeline View
blocks/timeline-view.description: Gantt-style bars on a day scale with a today line. Drag a bar to move its date; off-screen items show an edge arrow.

blocks/to-do.title: To-do
blocks/to-do.description: The to-do list item: a 16px checkbox; checked items are struck through and faded.

blocks/toggle.title: Toggle
blocks/toggle.description: The toggle list: a disclosure triangle that shows or hides nested blocks. An open toggle with no children shows a clickable “Empty toggle” hint.

blocks/topbar.title: Topbar
blocks/topbar.description: The 44px bar above a page: breadcrumbs on the left, page actions on the right. Inside an AppFrame it adds the phone menu button that opens the sidebar drawer.

blocks/turn-into-menu.title: Turn into menu
blocks/turn-into-menu.description: The “Turn into” list: convert a block to another type. The current type is checked. Used as a submenu of the block menu and of the text toolbar.

blocks/view-settings-panel.title: View Settings Panel
blocks/view-settings-panel.description: The “View settings” panel from the toolbar: view name, layout, property visibility, filter, sort, group and data source settings.

foundation/color.title: Color
foundation/color.description: Motion color tokens. Each swatch shows the light value on the left and the dark value on the right.

foundation/icons.title: Icons
foundation/icons.description: 257 icons drawn from Lucide (ISC), rendered with <Icon name="…" />. The 80 portable names work in every KrackedUI system.

foundation/motion.title: Motion
foundation/motion.description: Durations and easings for animation. Overlays fade and slide in and out; with reduced motion, nothing slides or scales.

foundation/radius.title: Radius
foundation/radius.description: Small radii keep Motion quiet: 4–6px for controls, 8px for popovers and cards. `--ds-radius-*` maps onto the same scale.

foundation/shadows.title: Shadows
foundation/shadows.description: Shadows combine a hairline outline with a soft drop, so surfaces read in both themes. Dark mode uses stronger values automatically.

foundation/spacing.title: Spacing
foundation/spacing.description: A 4px scale. Stack and Grid `gap` take the step number (`gap={4}` = 16px); `--ds-space-<n>` holds the same values.

foundation/typography.title: Typography
foundation/typography.description: Text styles used across Motion, from page titles to captions and code. Utilities: `text-n-<style>` (e.g. `text-n-ui`).

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Install @krackedui/motion from npm, import one stylesheet and wrap your UI in <Theme>. Tailwind is not required.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Motion is a calm, content-first React design system: quiet surfaces, dense layouts and a full set of components, from buttons to a block editor and database views.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Full apps built only from @krackedui/motion. Open them live, or start your own project from one.

theming.title: Theming
theming.description: Light and dark appearance, design tokens, and how to use them in your own code.

ui/accordion.title: Accordion
ui/accordion.description: Expandable sections separated by hairlines. The chevron turns and the content animates its height (instant under reduced motion).

ui/alert.title: Alert
ui/alert.description: An inline message in the shape of a callout: tinted surface, tone icon, title and text, with an optional action and dismiss button.

ui/avatar.title: Avatar
ui/avatar.description: Person or workspace picture with an initial fallback: rounded squares for workspaces, circles for people.

ui/avatar-group.title: Avatar Group
ui/avatar-group.description: Overlapping facepile; extra people collapse into a “+N” chip.

ui/badge.title: Badge
ui/badge.description: Small status or count label: six tones in soft, solid and outline variants, all at 4.5:1 contrast or more.

ui/bar-chart.title: BarChart
ui/bar-chart.description: Compares categories with grouped or stacked bars, vertical or horizontal. Bars grow in once; category labels thin or truncate on narrow screens.

ui/breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
ui/breadcrumbs.description: Location in a hierarchy, as links separated by "/". Middle items collapse into a "…" menu when the row runs out of space.

ui/button.title: Button
ui/button.description: Text button in four contract variants (plus danger ghost) and three sizes (plus xl), with icons and a loading state.

ui/calendar.title: Calendar
ui/calendar.description: An inline month grid for picking one date: month caption with Today and arrows, 32px day cells, accent selection and a red today marker.

ui/card.title: Card
ui/card.description: A quiet surface that groups related content: a hairline border, an 8px radius and no shadow. Compose a header, content and footer inside.

ui/checkbox.title: Checkbox
ui/checkbox.description: A 16px box that fills with the accent and a white check. Supports a label, an indeterminate state, and every form attribute.

ui/color-menu.title: Color Menu
ui/color-menu.description: Text and background color pickers: a compact swatch grid and a labelled list.

ui/combobox.title: Combobox
ui/combobox.description: A searchable select for long lists, single or `multiple`. The trigger matches Select; the popover has a search field above a filtered list. Type to filter, arrows to move, Enter to pick.

ui/command-palette.title: Command Palette
ui/command-palette.description: Searchable list of commands and pages with keyboard navigation and shortcut hints, inline in a panel.

ui/command-palette-dialog.title: Command Palette Dialog
ui/command-palette-dialog.description: The command palette in a modal, toggled with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Full screen on phones.

ui/confirm-dialog.title: Confirm Dialog
ui/confirm-dialog.description: Small alert dialog to confirm or cancel a consequential action. Async confirms show a busy button until they finish.

ui/context-menu.title: Context Menu
ui/context-menu.description: Right-click menu with the same parts and look as Menu, opened at the pointer.

ui/data-table.title: DataTable
ui/data-table.description: Columns + rows with sorting, row selection, row click, skeleton loading, an empty state, responsive columns and a sticky header. Built on the Table primitives.

ui/date-menu.title: Date Menu
ui/date-menu.description: The date property menu from database views: a typed date field, a month grid, then End date / Date format / Include time / Remind rows and Clear. For a date form field, use Date Picker.

ui/date-picker.title: Date Picker
ui/date-picker.description: A date form field: a TextInput-style trigger showing the date that opens a Calendar in a popover. Clearable, with min / max.

ui/date-range-picker.title: Date Range Picker
ui/date-range-picker.description: A start/end date field with quick presets. Two months side by side on wide screens, one under 640px; the range previews as you hover or move with the keyboard.

ui/dialog.title: Dialog
ui/dialog.description: Modal dialog in three sizes with title, description and a footer of actions. Fills the width on phones and scrolls inside.

ui/disclosure-toggle.title: Disclosure Toggle
ui/disclosure-toggle.description: The ▸ triangle of toggle blocks and tree rows: rotates down when open.

ui/divider.title: Divider
ui/divider.description: Hairline separator, horizontal or vertical. `block` adds the spacing of a divider in a document.

ui/donut-chart.title: DonutChart
ui/donut-chart.description: Parts of a whole as a ring, with content in the middle and a legend of values and shares. Slices draw in once and lift on hover.

ui/drag-handle.title: Drag Handle
ui/drag-handle.description: The six-dot handle beside a block or row: drag to move, click to open the block menu.

ui/emoji-picker.title: Emoji Picker
ui/emoji-picker.description: Emoji and icon picker panel with search, category jumps and an upload tab. Put it in a Popover.

ui/empty-state.title: EmptyState
ui/empty-state.description: What to show when there is nothing yet: a quiet icon, a one-line title, a sentence of help and the next action.

ui/field.title: Field
ui/field.description: Label, description and error around one control. It wires `id`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required` into the control, so every input in a form is announced correctly.

ui/file-upload.title: File Upload
ui/file-upload.description: A drop zone plus a "Choose files" button, with type, size and count validation and a removable file list.

ui/form-patterns.title: Form Patterns
ui/form-patterns.description: A complete payment form built only from the package: Field around every control, validation on submit, errors that say how to fix the value, and a status message on success.

ui/grid.title: Grid
ui/grid.description: Equal columns (1–6 or 12) with gaps from the spacing scale, per breakpoint.

ui/icon-button.title: Icon Button
ui/icon-button.description: Square, icon-only button for toolbars, sidebars and row actions, with a required label and an optional tooltip.

ui/kanban-board.title: KanbanBoard
ui/kanban-board.description: Cards in status columns that people move by dragging (mouse, pen or touch) or with the keyboard through each card’s menu. Controlled: it reports moves, you update the list.

ui/kbd.title: Kbd
ui/kbd.description: Keyboard key or shortcut chip, like “⌘K” next to Search. `Shortcut` is the plain text variant used at the end of menu rows.

ui/line-chart.title: LineChart
ui/line-chart.description: Trends over time for one or more series: nice y ticks, a hairline grid, optional area fill and monotone curves. Fills its container and thins x labels on narrow screens.

ui/link.title: Link
ui/link.description: Text link: inline in running text, accent for UI links, subtle for secondary links. `external` opens a new tab safely.

ui/menu.title: Menu
ui/menu.description: Dropdown menu of actions opened from a button: items with icons and shortcuts, checkbox and radio options, submenus, a search header and a metadata footer.

ui/number-input.title: Number Input
ui/number-input.description: A numeric field with min / max / step, arrow-key stepping and Intl formatting (currency, percent, units) when it isn’t being edited. Accepts localized input like "1.234,5".

ui/page-icon.title: Page Icon
ui/page-icon.description: A page’s icon: emoji, icon or image, with the default page glyph when none is set. Sized for sidebar rows, table cells, callouts and page titles.

ui/pagination.title: Pagination
ui/pagination.description: Previous / next and page numbers with ellipses for long ranges. Under 640px it collapses to "Page 3 of 10" between the arrows.

ui/placeholder.title: Placeholder
ui/placeholder.description: Hint text for empty content: “Empty” values, untitled pages and blank blocks.

ui/popover.title: Popover
ui/popover.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, for pickers, small forms and details. Collision-aware and animated.

ui/progress.title: Progress
ui/progress.description: A determinate progress bar with a label and a value. The fill uses the tone color and grows with a short transition.

ui/radio-group.title: Radio Group
ui/radio-group.description: Mutually exclusive options. Each Radio is a 16px ring that fills with the accent and a white dot when selected.

ui/search-input.title: Search Input
ui/search-input.description: Search field with a leading magnifier and a clear button that appears once there is text. Escape clears too.

ui/segmented-control.title: Segmented Control
ui/segmented-control.description: A small set of exclusive options shown inline, from view settings and layout pickers. The selected surface slides between segments.

ui/select.title: Select
ui/select.description: Pick one option from a short list. The trigger looks like a text field; the list is a Motion menu with a check on the selected row and typeahead.

ui/share-popover.title: Share Popover
ui/share-popover.description: Share panel: invite by email, people with access, general access and copy link. Put it in a Popover.

ui/sheet.title: Sheet
ui/sheet.description: Modal panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom edge, with a pinned footer. Fills the width on phones.

ui/skeleton.title: Skeleton
ui/skeleton.description: A loading placeholder shaped like the content: a quiet grey block or a few text lines that pulse gently, and hold still under reduced motion.

ui/slider.title: Slider
ui/slider.description: Pick a number or a range by dragging or with the arrow keys. A 4px track, accent range and white thumbs; thumbs grow on touch screens.

ui/sparkline.title: Sparkline
ui/sparkline.description: A tiny inline trend line with no axes, for stat cards and table cells. Fills its container unless you give it a width.

ui/spinner.title: Spinner
ui/spinner.description: Loading indicator: a thin ring with a spinning arc. Announced as a status (“Loading” by default).

ui/stack.title: Stack
ui/stack.description: Flex row or column with gaps from the 4px spacing scale. Direction and gap can change per breakpoint.

ui/stat.title: Stat
ui/stat.description: A key metric: label, a large tabular value, a delta chip whose color follows whether the change is good, and a line of context.

ui/status-pill.title: Status Pill
ui/status-pill.description: A colored dot and label on a rounded tint, with shortcuts for the default groups: not started, in progress, done.

ui/steps.title: Steps
ui/steps.description: Progress through a multi-step task (checkout, a payment, onboarding): numbered markers joined by hairlines; completed steps can link back.

ui/switch.title: Switch
ui/switch.description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately: a 30×18 pill track with a white knob.

ui/table.title: Table
ui/table.description: Styled table primitives in the look of Motion’s database table: 36px rows, hairline rules, a quiet header. The table scrolls inside its own container on small screens.

ui/tabs.title: Tabs
ui/tabs.description: Underline tabs to switch between views of the same context. The underline slides to the active tab.

ui/tag.title: Tag
ui/tag.description: Colored label for user-defined categories in the ten palette colors, with an optional remove button.

ui/text-input.title: Text Input
ui/text-input.description: Single-line field: a translucent grey box with a hairline ring that turns blue on focus and red when invalid. Optional leading icon and trailing content.

ui/textarea.title: Textarea
ui/textarea.description: Multi-line field with the Text Input surface (14/20 text), resizable vertically.

ui/theme.title: Theme
ui/theme.description: The Motion root: applies fonts, tokens, base styles and the light/dark appearance to everything inside, including portalled menus and dialogs.

ui/timeline.title: Timeline
ui/timeline.description: A Gantt-style chart: one bar per item from its start to its end date, on a week or month scale, with a today marker. Bars open on click or Enter and move with drag or the arrow keys.

ui/toast.title: Toast
ui/toast.description: Short, temporary message at the bottom center after an action, with an optional action like Undo. `ToastProvider` hosts them; `useToast()` shows and dismisses them.

ui/tooltip.title: Tooltip
ui/tooltip.description: Short hint on hover and keyboard focus, with an optional shortcut line. Dark in both themes.
